sources.title: DOG September 2025 primary clinical-society statement
sources.read_extent: Physical page 1, dated header and prevalence context only
sources.check_performed: Clinical society states around seven million people have AMD including different stages; cataract can overlap. Supports broad scale and disease-at-risk interpretation. Does not independently reconstruct a deduplicated September 2026 count of every constituency in DBSV definition.
sources.temporal_limit: Rough clinical estimate, not a current national census. No summation of overlapping eye-disease counts; not a blindness-only number.

sources.title: Korb et al., Gutenberg Health Study, 2014
sources.read_extent: Primary article indexed abstract: methods, results, conclusion
sources.check_performed: Fundus photographs from 4,340 regional German participants aged 35–74, independently graded. Early AMD 11.9 percent and late AMD 0.2 percent; age-specific differences large. Broad population extrapolations, stages and age bounds differ from diagnosed blindness counts.
sources.temporal_limit: Original abstract only, not full paper or reconstructed national extrapolation. Does not settle exact composite 2026 count.
